name: Debtors Report
query:
SELECT  COALESCE(gsi.name, "TOTAL") AS "Invoice No:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
        IF(gsi.name IS NULL, "", gsi.customer) AS "Customer:Link/Customer:200",
        IF(gsi.name IS NULL, "", gsi.property) AS "Property:Link/Property:150",
        IF(gsi.name IS NULL, "", gsi.unit) AS "Unit:Link/Unit Master:130",
        gsi.cost_center AS "Cost Center:Data:200",
        gsi.item AS "Items:Data:300",
        gsi.from_date AS "From Date:Date:100",
        gsi.to_date AS "To Date:Date:100",
        gsi.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:100",
        FORMAT(SUM(gsi.usd),2) AS "USD:Decimal/2:100",
        FORMAT(SUM(gsi.tzs),2) AS "TZS:Decimal/2:100",
        gsi._user_tags AS "Remarks:Data:200"
FROM (
    SELECT  si.name,
            si.customer,
            si.cost_center,
            l_old.property AS property,
            la.unit AS unit,
            GROUP_CONCAT(sid.item_name) AS "item",
            si.from_date,
            si.to_date,
            si.due_date,
            si.currency,
            MAX(IF(si.currency = "USD", IF(si.currency = si.party_account_currency, si.outstanding_amount, si.outstanding_amount/si.conversion_rate), 0)) AS "usd",
            MAX(IF(si.currency = "TZS", IF(si.currency = si.party_account_currency, si.outstanding_amount, si.outstanding_amount*si.conversion_rate), 0)) AS "tzs",
            si._user_tags
    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
    LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` AS sid ON si.name = sid.parent
    LEFT JOIN `tabLease` l_old ON l_old.name = si.lease
    LEFT JOIN `tabLease Agreement Invoice Schedule` lais ON lais.sales_invoice = si.name
    LEFT JOIN `tabLease Agreement` la ON la.name = lais.parent
    WHERE si.status IN ("Partly Paid", "Unpaid", "Unpaid and Discounted", "Partly Paid and Discounted", "Overdue and Discounted", "Overdue")
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
      AND (%(tenant)s IS NULL OR %(tenant)s = '' OR si.customer = %(tenant)s)
      AND (%(property)s IS NULL OR %(property)s = '' OR l_old.property = %(property)s OR la.property = %(property)s)
      AND (%(unit)s IS NULL OR %(unit)s = '' OR la.unit = %(unit)s)
    GROUP BY si.name
) gsi
GROUP BY gsi.customer, gsi.name WITH ROLLUP
